forum.title: Creating Custom prototype reference from N6 DK and N6 Nucleo
forum.category: STM32 MCUs Boards and hardware tools
forum.best_answer_content:
Hello,

You have the NUCLEO-N657X0-Q board as an example:

<https://www.st.com/en/evaluation-tools/nucleo-n657x0-q.html#overview>

The CAD files are here, Altium format:

<https://www.st.com/en/evaluation-tools/nucleo-n657x0-q.html#cad-resources>

For the restriction part of your question, please check the STM32N6 documentation here:

<https://www.st.com/en/microcontrollers-microprocessors/stm32n6-series/documentation.html>

You might be interrested in the Errata Sheet of the STM32N6.
